title: Kim's Karate and Learning Center

services.name: Karate-Like Taekwondo
services.desc: Kim’s Karate was started in 1970 by 9th Degree Black Belt Master Jae Kim. In 30 years, Kim’s karate has become the largest chain of Martial Arts schools on the East Coast with over 35 schools in Maryland, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Virginia, Florida and California. After School Program, We offer a full licensed daycare open all days according to the public schools, also open on a majority of days when schools are out providing full day daycare, Open on most snow days, and days when school are closed. Karate classes are included in this program. Summer Camp Open 7AM to 6PM offering trips to go on everyday including swimming, library, bounce around, wheels skating center, and many more. Snacks
